label: input m at original position 4+ in sequences starting with r
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.02% of steps). Fires only in the original phase at positions 4-7 (and weakly on <DEL>, 7% of mass); never in the copy phase or at t<3. Input token m carries 73% of activation mass (21x lift), but only ~0.7% of m inputs fire, so m is necessary-ish but far from sufficient. The strongest additional condition is that the sequence starts with r (first_tok r, 19x lift, 67% of mass); top activations are all r ... m with intervening letters such as o, w, e, s, v, x, z (prev_tok s/e/f/v favoured). The conjunction m at orig_idx>=4 with first token r gives dev P=0.26, R=0.29, mass recall 0.41; strongest activations are covered best (47% of top quartile). Many inactive cases match the predicate (e.g. r q k v v u m), suggesting dependence on a hidden-state configuration from the specific intermediate letters that a simple predicate cannot capture. Prefix-set predicates (n_seen of o/w/e/s/v/x/z/c/f) did not help. Residual low-magnitude firings occur on other tokens (o, k, 1, a, ...) in r-initial sequences.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=r (+6.13), prev_tok=s (+3.77), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=m (+3.25), phase=0 & in_tok=m (+3.25), orig1=w (+3.20), orig2=w (+3.07). Lower it: phase=2 (-3.50), prev3_tok=- (-3.25), t=3 (-2.98), orig3=p (-1.97).
